description: Buy a plan (plan + period) or a credit top-up (credits) for the signed-in account (needs an API key: from VIVIDEO_API_KEY, start_signup or verify_login_code). Returns a Stripe checkout_url: SHOW IT TO YOUR USER to pay. It never pays by itself. Then call get_checkout. Credits need a plan first (402 plan_required).

credits.description: Credit top-up instead of a plan.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse to get the same checkout back on a retry.

name: start_checkout
